sections.title: How long is a Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: Most full-time courses last three years (six semesters) and are worth 180 ECTS credits. The precise structure depends on the institution.

sections.title: Can Indian students study Civil Engineering in Switzerland after 12th?
sections.lead: Yes, provided they satisfy the university’s academic eligibility criteria for their country of origin. Some applicants may need to have additional qualifications / entrance examination.

sections.title: Is IELTS compulsory for Civil Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: Not necessarily. Many bachelor’s programs are taught predominantly in German or French, so it may be more important to be proficient in the relevant language than to have IELTS. Always check the university’s own regulations.

sections.title: Do you offer any English-taught Bachelor's programs in Civil Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: There are limited fully English-taught options. Some individual courses may be taught in English but this does not imply that the entire bachelor’s degree is in English.

sections.title: What are my possibilities after studying Civil Engineering for a Bachelor’s in Switzerland?
sections.lead: You can continue to study structural engineering, geotechnics, transportation, water resources or infrastructure systems. Career opportunities may include civil engineering, construction, structural design and project engineering, depending on your qualifications and work authorization.
